description: This file defines a singleton class 'LiveActivityManager' responsible for managing Live Activities related to connection states in an iOS app, including starting, updating, and pruning activities, with emphasis on connection lifecycle management and cleanup.

classes.name: LiveActivityManager
classes.description: A singleton class for managing live activity lifecycle, connection states, and cleanup in an iOS app.

methods.name: startActivity
methods.description: Starts a new live activity with provided agent name and session key, or handles connection if already active.

methods.name: handleConnecting
methods.description: Updates the current activity state to 'connecting'.

methods.name: handleReconnect
methods.description: Updates the current activity state to 'idle'.

methods.name: handleDisconnect
methods.description: Updates the current activity state to 'disconnected'.
